notes: Source structural hypothesis: existing native cross-RX supervision touches shallow time_down and middle t2.pool only for L. Existing RXPSM U target/prototype/feature losses act on final z_id. Extend the exact native descriptors/channel normalization to U without a new head or extra student forward.

Pair target q_ij is dot product of detached sharpened existing U teacher distributions; positive pairs require same teacher argmax and different original source RX; negatives different argmax.
